title: Bihar Student Swaps School Bag With Mother's Stylish Purse, Internet Loves His Confidence: 'Fashion Show Ka Scene' | Viral News - News18
text: When in Bihar, expect the unexpected. What would you do when stepping out for school and realise that your backpack is missing? Well, for one young student, it was just an opportunity to experiment with fashion as he simply carried his mother’s handbag, hanging over his shoulder with effortless style. The confidence as he flaunted the accessory? According to the Internet, he just hit it out of the park. In a deeply funny moment caught on camera, the student from Bihar displays his unique approach to school gear. It shows him sitting on the backseat of the bicycle of a friend who is riding the vehicle as both head for the school, dressed in white shirts. But instead of a standard backpack, the young boy had his mother’s stylish purse hanging on his shoulder. What Was Inside The Bag Someone captured the precise second the young boy strolled past with the bag, looking completely unbothered by the mismatch. The man behind the camera even asked him to open the bag, eager to see what was inside and guess what? There were books, notebooks and other stationery items required in the school. What made the clip stand out was not just the black embellished handbag but the confidence of the young boy as he carried the same in the most fashionable way possible. Internet Is All Praises For Boy As expected, viewers reacted to the clip, turning the comment section into a laugh riot. While the scene is undeniably funny, many pointed out that the boy’s creativity is actually quite impressive, showing his determination to get to school regardless of what he uses to carry his supplies. One of the comments read, “Respect he is not shy but proud of the things available." Another joined in saying," At least he is studying. We should appreciate his efforts." An individual stepped in with a broader view of the situation. They wrote, “One day some guy will walk with this bag at Milan fashion week and it will become stylish." A funny comment read, “Bihari bhai .. korean se inspired hai." Someone else wrote, “Matlab ye alag hi leval ka banda hai." And that’s how a simple lack of a school bag turned into a masterclass in confidence, proving that as long as you are self-assured, the bag is just a detail.
